metadata.editorial_policy: Listing order on each board is editorial and is not influenced by payment. No program pays to appear on a board. External links are reviewed at least quarterly.

boards.title: Crisis and urgent support
boards.summary: Use these resources when safety is the priority. ViableMHR is not emergency care. If someone is in immediate physical danger, call 911. For mental health or substance use crisis, call or text 988.
